item.title: 首款触屏 MacBook Pro 今日发售，M6 款同步开卖
item.guid: 首款触屏-MacBook-Pro-今日发售，M6-款同步开卖
item.description:
Apple will officially launch two new MacBook Pro product lines in mainland China on November 6th. Models featuring PROLED XDR displays will be available in 14-inch and 16-inch versions, powered by M5 Pro or M5 Max chips. 苹果将于 11 月 6 日在中国大陆正式发售两条新款 MacBook Pro 产品线。采用 PROLED XDR 显示屏的机型提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸版本，搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max 芯片。

The touchscreen models feature a dual-layer tandem OLED panel, supporting multi-touch gestures such as scrolling, pinch-to-zoom, and rotation. Apple has also introduced Dynamic Island to this product line and redesigned the thermal system. 触屏款采用双层串联 OLED 面板，支持滚动、双指开合和旋转等多点触控手势。苹果也在这条产品线上引入了灵动岛，并重新设计了散热系统。

Another 14-inch MacBook Pro, also released on the same day, is powered by the M6 chip, features a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU, and retains the Liquid Retina XDR display. 同一天发售的另一款 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 搭载 M6 芯片，配备 12 核 CPU 和 12 核 GPU，沿用 Liquid 视网膜 XDR 显示屏。

🔗 Related reading: MacBook Pro now has a touchscreen, but that's its smallest upgrade | Includes buying guide 🔗 相关阅读： MacBook Pro 能触屏了，但这只是它最小的升级｜附选购指南

item.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber，首批开放给获批的安全团队
item.guid: OpenAI-发布-GPT-6-Cyber，首批开放给获批的安全团队
item.description:
OpenAI has released the cybersecurity model GPT-6 Cyber, with the first batch available via API and Codex to selected approved Daybreak Red clients. OpenAI rated its cybersecurity capabilities as the highest "Critical" level, while the previous generation GPT-5.6 Cyber was rated "High." OpenAI 发布网络安全模型 GPT-6 Cyber，首批通过 API 和 Codex 向部分获批的 Daybreak Red 客户开放。OpenAI 将它在网络安全方面的能力评为最高的「关键」级，上代 GPT-5.6 Cyber 的评级为「高」。

In OpenAI's Linux kernel research, GPT-6 Cyber reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities and developed working local privilege escalation exploits for 948 of them. The research team disclosed 304 critical findings to maintainers according to Linux community guidelines and provided candidate patches. 在 OpenAI 的 Linux 内核研究中，GPT-6 Cyber 复现了 1724 项漏洞，为其中 948 项开发出可运行的本地提权利用方式。研究团队按 Linux 社区指引向维护者披露了其中 304 项关键发现，并提供候选补丁。

The model also found 81 previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities in Firefox and assisted in drafting patches. OpenAI states that Mozilla has fixed many of these vulnerabilities. 模型也在 Firefox 中找到了 81 项此前未知的高危漏洞，并协助拟定补丁。OpenAI 称，Mozilla 已修复其中多项漏洞。

🔗 Related reading: Just now, GPT-6 Cyber officially released, AI's strongest spear also became its strongest shield 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，GPT-6 Cyber 正式发布，AI 最强的矛也成了最强的盾

item.title: DeepSeek Harness 单日活跃用户达 154 万，团队拟建官方插件市场
item.guid: DeepSeek-Harness-单日活跃用户达-154-万，团队拟建官方插件市场
item.description:
The DeepSeek Harness team announced usage data after the desktop version's launch on November 5th. Based on users utilizing the official API, daily active users reached 1.54 million on November 4th, with a daily consumption of approximately 92 trillion tokens. DeepSeek Harness 团队 11 月 5 日公布了桌面端上线后的使用数据。以使用官方 API 的用户为统计范围，11 月 4 日单日活跃用户达到 154 万，日消耗约 92 万亿个 Token。

The team stated that third-party plugins have increased to about 35,000, with approximately 60% of active users having created or installed at least one. Harness's built-in features can also be replaced by third-party plugins. The team plans to build an official plugin marketplace, improve the stability and compatibility of plugin interfaces, and perfect security mechanisms. 团队称，第三方插件已增至约 3.5 万个，约六成活跃用户制作或安装过至少一款。Harness 的内置功能也可以被第三方插件替换。团队计划建设官方插件市场，改进插件接口的稳定性和兼容性，并完善安全机制。

A support program for plugin authors is currently soliciting interest, with the team proposing support methods including Token incentives, technical exchanges, and work recommendations. 面向插件作者的支持计划正在征集意向，团队提出的支持方式包括 Token 激励、技术交流和作品推荐。

item.title: 丰田将设立直属机器人部门，由首席生产官兼任负责人
item.guid: 丰田将设立直属机器人部门，由首席生产官兼任负责人
item.description:
Toyota Motor announced on November 5 that it will establish Toyota Robotics, a directly managed company, on January 1, 2027, with Executive Officer and Chief Production Officer Takefumi Shiga concurrently serving as its head. 丰田汽车 11 月 5 日宣布，将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日设立直属公司管理的 Toyota Robotics，由执行役员兼首席生产官志贺武文兼任负责人。

Toyota will consolidate its scattered robotics technologies, personnel, and functions into the new department, and list robotics as one of the key pillars of its future business. The new department will collaborate with development teams to promote the application, commercialization, and deployment of robots based on actual needs from the manufacturing front lines. 丰田将把分散在公司内部的机器人技术、人员和职能集中到新部门，并把机器人列为未来业务的关键支柱之一。新部门将与开发团队合作，从制造一线的实际需求出发，推动机器人的应用、商业化和部署。

The same round of adjustments will also abolish the Carbon Neutral Engineering Development Center, merging relevant talent and functions into the Powertrain Company, with a focus shifting to the planning and development of hybrid power systems. 同一轮调整还将撤销碳中和工程开发中心，把相关人才与职能并入动力总成公司，重点转向混合动力系统的规划和开发。

item.title: Claude Code 前产品负责人加入 OpenAI，掌管核心产品
item.guid: Claude-Code-前产品负责人加入-OpenAI，掌管核心产品
item.description:
Cat Wu, who previously led Claude Code and Cowork products, announced on November 5 that she has joined OpenAI to oversee product management for core products. She specifically mentioned collaborating with OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux to develop agents for individuals and teams, with users retaining control. 曾负责 Claude Code 和 Cowork 产品的 Cat Wu 于 11 月 5 日宣布加入 OpenAI，负责核心产品的产品管理。她点名将与 OpenAI 的 Thibault Sottiaux 合作，开发面向个人和团队、由用户保有控制权的智能体。

On the same morning, Austin Lau, who previously helped build Anthropic's growth team, also announced that he had recently joined OpenAI. 同日上午，曾参与搭建 Anthropic 增长团队的 Austin Lau 也宣布自己近期已加入 OpenAI。

🔗 Related reading: Breaking! Claude Code's "Product Queen" joins OpenAI, announced departure just the day before 🔗 相关阅读： 突发！Claude Code 「产品一姐」加入OpenAI，前一天刚宣布离职

item.title: 三季度全球 DRAM 营收逼近 2000 亿美元，价格上涨是主因
item.guid: 三季度全球-DRAM-营收逼近-2000-亿美元，价格上涨是主因
item.description:
A tracking report released by Counterpoint Research shows that global DRAM revenue in Q3 2026 approached $200 billion, a year-on-year increase of 369%. During the same period, DRAM bit shipments only increased by about 4% quarter-on-quarter, and the average selling price rose to $1.9 per Gb. Counterpoint attributes this surge in revenue primarily to rising prices, with demand from AI accelerators and data centers intensifying the competition among manufacturers for supply. Counterpoint Research 发布的跟踪报告显示，2026 年第三季度全球 DRAM 营收接近 2000 亿美元，同比增长 369%。同期 DRAM 位元出货量环比仅增约 4%，平均售价升至每 Gb 1.9 美元。Counterpoint 将这轮营收大涨主要归因于价格上升，AI 加速器和数据中心的需求加剧了厂商对货源的争夺。

By revenue, Samsung ranked first with a 38% share, while SK Hynix's revenue grew by over 40% quarter-on-quarter, narrowing the gap with Samsung. ChangXin Memory's revenue share decreased from 10% in the previous quarter to 9%. 按营收计算，三星以 38% 的份额居首，SK 海力士营收环比增长逾 40%，缩小了与三星的差距。长鑫存储的营收份额从上季度的 10% 降至 9%。

item.title: 全球平板出货创近三年新低，前五厂商仅联想增长
item.guid: 全球平板出货创近三年新低，前五厂商仅联想增长
item.description:
Data released by Omdia shows that global tablet shipments in the third quarter were approximately 32 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 23%, marking the lowest level in nearly three years. The decline in the previous quarter was 10%, with particularly noticeable drops in the Middle East, China, and Western European markets this quarter. Omdia 公布的数据显示，第三季度全球平板电脑出货量约 3200 万台，同比下降 23%，为近三年来的最低水平。上一季度的跌幅为 10%，中东、中国和西欧市场本季度的跌幅尤其明显。

Apple still led with a 36% share, but its shipments decreased by about 28% year-on-year. Huawei saw the largest decline among the top five manufacturers, down 43% year-on-year. Lenovo ranked third with approximately 4.1 million units, with shipments growing by about 12% year-on-year, making it the only brand among the top five to grow, primarily driven by mainstream tablets. 苹果仍以 36% 的份额居首，但出货量同比下降约 28%。华为同比下降 43%，在前五家厂商中跌幅最大。联想以约 410 万台排在第三，出货同比增长约 12%，是前五家中唯一增长的品牌，增量主要来自普通平板。

Omdia pointed out that tight component supply has limited the configuration upgrades of new products, and some consumers may continue to postpone replacing their devices. Omdia 指出，元器件供应紧张限制了新品的配置升级，部分消费者可能继续推迟换机。

item.title: 鸿蒙电脑累计发货破百万，华为带来政企台式机与企业版
item.guid: 鸿蒙电脑累计发货破百万，华为带来政企台式机与企业版
item.description:
Huawei Consumer Business Group announced that as of October 31, cumulative shipments of HarmonyOS PCs have exceeded 1 million units, with over 21,000 applications available. Richard Yu, in forwarding this data, also announced the launch of the Qingyun HM650 series for enterprise office use and the HarmonyOS PC Enterprise Edition. 华为终端公布，截至 10 月 31 日，鸿蒙电脑累计发货量突破 100 万台，已上架的应用超过 2.1 万款。余承东在转发这一数据时同时宣布，面向企业办公的擎云 HM650 系列和鸿蒙电脑企业版亮相。

The HM650 series is Huawei's HarmonyOS desktop PC for the government and enterprise market. Zhu Dongdong, President of Huawei Consumer Business Group's Tablet and PC Product Line, also previewed at the Office Industry Summit that another new HarmonyOS PC product will begin its warm-up next week. HM650 系列是华为面向政企市场的鸿蒙台式机。华为终端平板与 PC 产品线总裁朱懂东还在办公产业峰会上预告，另一款鸿蒙电脑新品将于下周开始预热。

At the summit, He Gang, CEO of Huawei Consumer Business Group, predicted that the number of devices running HarmonyOS 6 or 7 would exceed 100 million by late November. Ning Shenglan, President of Global Ecosystem Development at Huawei Consumer Business Group, introduced that there are over 21,000 independent applications for HarmonyOS PCs, and Huawei and its partners train over 100,000 HarmonyOS developers monthly. 峰会上，华为终端 BG CEO 何刚预计，搭载 HarmonyOS 6 或 7 的设备数量将在 11 月下旬突破 1 亿台。华为终端 BG 全球生态发展总裁宁胜蓝介绍，鸿蒙电脑独立应用已超过 2.1 万款，华为和合作伙伴每月培养超过 10 万名鸿蒙开发者。

item.title: 杨元庆给联想 PC 定下长期目标：全球份额 30%
item.guid: 杨元庆给联想-PC-定下长期目标：全球份额-30%
item.description:
According to a report by Yicai, Yang Yuanqing, Chairman and CEO of Lenovo Group, stated at the Global Industry Analyst Conference that Lenovo is moving towards a long-term goal of 30% global PC market share. IDC data shows that Lenovo shipped 14.9 million PCs globally in the third quarter of this year, with a market share of 23.8%. 据第一财经报道，联想集团董事长兼 CEO 杨元庆在全球行业分析师大会上表示，联想正朝着全球 PC 市场份额 30% 的长期目标迈进。IDC 数据显示，联想今年第三季度在全球出货 1490 万台 PC，市场份额为 23.8%。

Against the backdrop of tight supply and rising prices, Yang Yuanqing predicted that PC shipments would face pressure in the short term. He stated that increasing revenue per unit can offset some of the impact of declining shipments. 在供应紧张、价格上涨的背景下，杨元庆预计，PC 出货量短期内会面临压力。他表示，单机收入正在提高，可以抵消部分出货下降带来的影响。

item.title: Switch 2 第二财季卖出 267 万台，同比减少约四成
item.guid: Switch-2-第二财季卖出-267-万台，同比减少约四成
item.description:
Nintendo announced its semi-annual results as of the end of September. Switch 2 sold 6.49 million units from April to September, with game software selling 24.49 million copies. "Splatoon: Strikers" was released in July, with sales reaching 2.42 million copies by the end of the period. During the same period, the original Switch still sold 1.27 million units, and software sales were 65.73 million copies. 任天堂公布截至 9 月底的半年度业绩。Switch 2 在 4 月至 9 月售出 649 万台，游戏软件卖出 2449 万份。《斯普拉遁：突袭者》在 7 月推出，截至期末销量为 242 万份。同期初代 Switch 仍售出 127 万台，软件销量为 6573 万份。

Nintendo's revenue for the first half of the fiscal year was 966.041 billion yen, a year-on-year decrease of 12.1%, while operating profit increased by 49.1% year-on-year to 216.5 billion yen. Nintendo attributed the operating profit growth to a higher proportion of software sales and a refund of US tariffs previously included in the cost of sales received in the first fiscal quarter. The company maintained its full-year performance outlook. 任天堂上半财年营收为 9660.41 亿日元，同比下降 12.1%，营业利润同比增长 49.1% 至 2165 亿日元。任天堂将营业利润增长归因于软件销售占比提高，以及第一财季收到此前计入销售成本的美国关税退款。公司维持全年业绩预期。

Quarterly, Switch 2 sold 2.67 million units in the second fiscal quarter, lower than the 4.54 million units in the same period last year, and also less than the 3.82 million units in the first fiscal quarter. Nintendo still expects Switch 2 sales to be 16.5 million units this fiscal year. 按季度看，Switch 2 第二财季卖出 267 万台，低于上年同期的 454 万台，也少于第一财季的 382 万台。任天堂仍预计本财年 Switch 2 销量为 1650 万台。

item.title: 混元 Hy4 上线首日调用激增，腾讯称扩容十倍
item.guid: 混元-Hy4-上线首日调用激增，腾讯称扩容十倍
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan stated that Hy4 was first integrated into WorkBuddy on November 4th, and on its launch day, a large number of users reached their usage limits. The team has urgently expanded the Hy4 inference cluster tenfold and increased users' free trial quotas. 腾讯混元表示，Hy4 于 11 月 4 日在 WorkBuddy 首发接入，上线首日就有大量用户触及使用额度。团队已将 Hy4 推理集群紧急扩容十倍，并提高了用户的免费体验额度。

Tencent stated that individual users might still hit limits during peak hours, suggesting switching to models like Hy3 when encountering limits, or deferring non-urgent tasks to the evening. The free trial for Hy3 on WorkBuddy has been extended until 23:59 on November 15th. 腾讯称，高峰时段仍可能有个别用户触及限额，建议遇到限额时切换到 Hy3 等模型，也可以把非紧急任务放到晚间。WorkBuddy 上的 Hy3 限免延长至 11 月 15 日 23:59。

item.title: Arm 第二财季营收创同期新高，数据中心版税翻倍
item.guid: Arm-第二财季营收创同期新高，数据中心版税翻倍
item.description:
Arm announced its second-quarter results for fiscal year 2027, ending September 30. The company's revenue for the quarter was $1.443 billion, a 27% year-over-year increase, setting a new record for a second fiscal quarter. Net profit, calculated according to GAAP, was $130 million, a 45% year-over-year decrease. Arm 公布截至 9 月 30 日的 2027 财年第二季度业绩。公司当季营收 14.43 亿美元，同比增长 27%，创第二财季纪录。按 GAAP 计算，净利润 1.3 亿美元，同比下降 45%。

Licensing and other revenue grew by 50% to $773 million, with Arm attributing the growth to intellectual property demand and the timing of recognizing multiple large licensing agreements. Royalty revenue increased by 8% to $670 million, with data center royalties doubling year-over-year. Arm stated that increased data center deployments and the adoption of higher-rate technologies like Armv9 drove this growth, while the smartphone market was impacted by rising memory prices, offsetting some of the gains. 授权及其他收入增长 50% 至 7.73 亿美元，Arm 将增长归因于知识产权需求和多份大额授权合同的确认节奏。特许权使用费收入增长 8% 至 6.7 亿美元，其中数据中心特许权使用费同比翻倍。Arm 称，数据中心部署增加和费率更高的 Armv9 等技术普及带来增长，智能手机市场受到内存涨价冲击，抵消了部分增量。

item.title: 高通手机芯片季度收入下滑 26%，汽车芯片收入增长 89%
item.guid: 高通手机芯片季度收入下滑-26%，汽车芯片收入增长-89%
item.description:
Qualcomm announced its fourth-quarter results for fiscal year 2026, ending September 27. According to GAAP, revenue was $10.322 billion, an 8% year-over-year decline. Handset chip revenue decreased to $5.137 billion, a 26% drop, but still the highest revenue item in the chip business. 高通公布截至 9 月 27 日的 2026 财年第四季度业绩。按 GAAP 计算，营收 103.22 亿美元，同比下滑 8%。手机芯片收入降至 51.37 亿美元，降幅为 26%，仍是芯片业务中收入最高的一项。

Automotive chip revenue increased by 89% year-over-year to $1.99 billion, and IoT chip revenue increased by 4% to $1.888 billion. Qualcomm stated that costs in wafer manufacturing, packaging and testing, and memory have generally risen, and the company has adjusted product prices. It expects the impact to be fully reflected in the gross margin of its chip business in the second half of fiscal year 2027. 汽车芯片收入同比增长 89% 至 19.9 亿美元，物联网芯片收入同比增长 4% 至 18.88 亿美元。高通称，晶圆制造、封装测试及存储器等环节成本普遍上升，公司已调整产品价格，预计其影响将在 2027 财年下半年充分反映在芯片业务的毛利率中。

item.title: 国产视频模型公司 Sand.ai 完成 2 亿美元融资
item.guid: 国产视频模型公司-Sand.ai-完成-2-亿美元融资
item.description:
Sand.ai announced on November 5th the completion of a $200 million Series A+ funding round, co-led by Cornerstone Capital and Wangsu Technology. The company stated this is its third round of financing this year, with a cumulative funding of $300 million in 10 months. Sand.ai 于 11 月 5 日宣布完成 2 亿美元 A+ 轮融资，由基石资本与网宿科技联合领投。公司称，这是其今年第三轮融资，10 个月累计融资 3 亿美元。

Sand.ai had previously opened up preview rights for its video model MAGI-2. According to Securities Times, the company plans to release the official version of MAGI-2, which uses a mixture-of-experts architecture, in the coming weeks. Wangsu Technology disclosed in September to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange its intention to participate in this funding round, with the announced target businesses including video generation model research and development and the music video tool VidMuse. Sand.ai 此前已开放视频模型 MAGI-2 的预览版权重。据《证券时报》报道，公司计划在接下来几周发布采用混合专家架构的 MAGI-2 正式版。网宿科技曾在 9 月向深交所披露拟参与本轮融资，公告列出的标的业务包括视频生成模型研发和音乐视频工具 VidMuse。

item.title: 游戏与影视带动索尼营业利润增长 45%，全年指引上调
item.guid: 游戏与影视带动索尼营业利润增长-45%，全年指引上调
item.description:
Sony announced its second-quarter results for the period ending September. Revenue from continuing operations was 3,429.4 billion yen, an increase of approximately 10% year-over-year, and operating profit was 622.3 billion yen, an increase of approximately 45% year-over-year. 索尼公布截至 9 月底的第二财季业绩。持续经营业务营收为 34294 亿日元，同比增长约 10%，营业利润为 6223 亿日元，同比增长约 45%。

Games & Network Services was the largest source of operating profit growth. Sony stated that increased sales of network services and first-party games, coupled with the absence of impairment charges for Bungie-related assets and development cost adjustments recorded in the same period last year, contributed to this quarter's performance. In the Pictures segment, the new Spider-Man film was the primary driver of theatrical revenue growth. 游戏及网络服务是营业利润增量的最大来源。索尼称，网络服务和第一方游戏销售增加，同时上年同期曾计入 Bungie 相关资产减值及开发成本调整，本季度少了这两项拖累。影视业务方面，新一部《蜘蛛侠》是院线收入增长的主要来源。

Sony raised its operating profit forecast for the current fiscal year from 1.72 trillion yen to 1.87 trillion yen. 索尼把本财年营业利润预期从 1.72 万亿日元上调至 1.87 万亿日元。

item.title: 💡 星尘智能创始人来杰：能进入家庭的机器人可能在明年出现
item.guid: 💡-星尘智能创始人来杰：能进入家庭的机器人可能在明年出现
item.description:
Lai Jie, founder and CEO of Stardust Intelligence, explained why the team chose a rope-driven structure using a cup as an example during an exclusive interview with iFanr. When a robot places a cup on a table, if it can perceive that the table is already supporting the cup, it can then release its grip. Lai Jie hopes robots learn about the changes in force when objects make contact. 星尘智能创始人兼 CEO 来杰在接受爱范儿专访时，用一个杯子解释了团队为什么选择绳驱结构。机器人把杯子放到桌上时，如果能感知桌面已经承托住杯子，就可以据此松手。来杰希望机器人学到的是物体接触时的受力变化。

In his view, transmitting power to joints with ropes allows robots to perceive external forces more clearly and also moves motors away from areas like wrists. He also divides embodied models and foundational large models into two layers: the former handles perception and action, the latter plans tasks, and the operating system connects the two. 在他看来，用绳索把动力传到关节，可以让机器人更清楚地感知外力，也能把电机从手腕等部位移开。他还把具身模型和基础大模型分在两个层次：前者处理感知和动作，后者规划任务，操作系统负责把两者接起来。

Lai Jie uses learning to cook from a video as an analogy for this division of labor: the person on the other end of the phone can tell you to first put oil in a hot pan, but picking up the oil bottle and controlling the pouring still needs to be done by yourself. He believes that having foundational large models receive all tactile data would lead to bandwidth and cost issues. Robots can first determine if they have a firm grip on a bottle, and then ask the large model for the next step only when needed. 来杰用视频学做饭比喻这种分工：电话另一端的人可以告诉你先往热锅里放油，拿起油瓶和控制倒油仍要由自己完成。他认为，让基础大模型接收全部触觉数据，会带来带宽和成本问题。机器人可以先判断瓶子有没有抓稳，需要时再向大模型询问下一步。

Lai Jie believes that current robots are still some distance from what he calls the 'iPhone 4 moment.' He predicts that robots capable of entering homes might appear next year. 来杰认为，当前的机器人离他所说的「iPhone 4 时刻」还有距离。他预计， 能进入家庭的机器人可能在明年出现。

🔗 Related reading: Interview with Lai Jie of Stardust Intelligence: The 'iPhone 4 moment' for robots hasn't arrived yet, but it might be closer than imagined | Diversity Company 🔗 相关阅读： 对话星尘智能来杰：机器人的「iPhone 4 时刻」还没到，但可能比想象中更近丨多样性公司

item.title: 纯电双座 smart 精灵 #2 豪华版上市，限时权益价 9.99 万元
item.guid: 纯电双座-smart-精灵-#2-豪华版上市，限时权益价-9.99-万元
item.description:
The smart #2 Premium Luxury Edition was launched in China on November 5th, with a limited-time promotional price of 99,900 yuan. This pure electric two-seater compact car continues the fortwo's short body and two-tone design, with a length of less than 2.8 meters and a minimum turning radius of 3.35 meters. smart 精灵 #2 Premium 豪华版于 11 月 5 日在国内上市，限时权益价 9.99 万元。这款纯电双座小车延续了 fortwo 的短车身和双色设计，车长不到 2.8 米，最小转弯半径为 3.35 米。

The new car is based on smart's ECA pure electric platform, featuring a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout. The Luxury Edition is equipped with a 60kW maximum power motor and a 35.8kWh lithium iron phosphate battery, offering a CLTC range of 410 kilometers. The rear retains an upper and lower split tailgate, and the interior features an 8.8-inch instrument display and a 12.8-inch central control screen, with a row of physical buttons below the central screen. 新车基于 smart 的 ECA 纯电平台，采用后置后驱布局。豪华版搭载最大功率 60kW 的电机和 35.8kWh 磷酸铁锂电池，CLTC 续航为 410 公里。车尾保留上下分体式尾门，车内有 8.8 英寸仪表屏和 12.8 英寸中控屏，中控屏下方留了一排实体按键。

item.title: 月之暗面开放 Kimi K3.1 Pro 权重
item.guid: 月之暗面开放-Kimi-K3.1-Pro-权重
item.description: Moonshot AI has released the full model weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro on Hugging Face. This model, which went live via API in October, uses a mixture-of-experts architecture, has a total of 2.8 trillion parameters, supports image input, and a 1 million Token context. Its dedicated license permits commercial use and requires retention of copyright and license statements upon distribution. 月之暗面在 Hugging Face 放出 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的完整模型权重。这个 10 月已通过 API 上线的模型采用混合专家架构，总参数 2.8 万亿，支持图像输入和 100 万 Token 上下文。其专用许可证允许商业使用，并要求分发时保留版权和许可声明。

item.title: 百度开放文心 5.5 Flash Base 权重，推理支持百万 Token 上下文
item.guid: 百度开放文心-5.5-Flash-Base-权重，推理支持百万-Token-上下文
item.description:
Baidu opened the base model weights for Wenxin 5.5 Flash Base on November 5, providing FP8 and BF16 versions on Hugging Face and Modata. 百度于 11 月 5 日开放文心 5.5 Flash Base 的基座模型权重，在 Hugging Face 和魔搭提供 FP8 与 BF16 两个版本。

The model adopts a mixed expert architecture with a total of 280 billion parameters, activating 14 billion parameters for each Token processed. The model was pre-trained from scratch using 33.5 trillion Tokens, with a maximum pre-training context of 128K, and fine-tuning and inference supporting up to 1 million Tokens. Baidu also provided deployment steps for SGLang and vLLM in the model card. 该模型采用混合专家架构，总参数量为 2800 亿，每处理一个 Token 激活其中 140 亿参数。模型从头预训练使用了 33.5 万亿个 Token，预训练上下文最长为 128K，微调与推理支持最长 100 万 Token。百度也在模型卡中给出了 SGLang 和 vLLM 的部署步骤。

item.title: Kimi 开放智能体云托管，企业可配置沙箱与联网权限
item.guid: Kimi-开放智能体云托管，企业可配置沙箱与联网权限
item.description:
Moonshot AI released Kimi Hosted Agents, encapsulating capabilities such as code execution, session management, and tool invocation required for agent operation into a cloud service. Enterprises can use it to deploy internal operations assistants or integrate customer service, investment research, and other agents into their own products. 月之暗面发布 Kimi Hosted Agents，将智能体运行所需的代码执行、会话管理和工具调用等能力封装成云服务。企业可用它在内部部署运维助手，也可将客服、投研等智能体接入自己的产品。

Developers can try it out in the Kimi API Open Platform console, or access it using API or command line. Tasks run in an independent sandbox, and enterprises can configure network access permissions, terminate sessions at any time, and export execution records for auditing. 开发者可在 Kimi API 开放平台的控制台试用，也能使用 API 或命令行接入。任务在独立沙箱中运行，企业可配置网络访问权限、随时中止会话，并导出执行记录供审计。

item.title: Claude 测试个人账本，可连接银行和信用卡查询开支
item.guid: Claude-测试个人账本，可连接银行和信用卡查询开支
item.description:
Anthropic launched personal finance features in Claude. Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers in the US will gradually gain access to testing this week, allowing them to connect bank and credit card accounts via Plaid to check balances, transactions, and bills. Anthropic 在 Claude 中推出个人财务功能。美国的 Pro、Max 和 Ultra 订阅者本周起陆续获得测试资格，可以通过 Plaid 连接银行和信用卡账户，查询余额、交易及账单。

Claude can summarize spending across different accounts, list expenses by category, and generate bill calendars or weekly spending charts. Users can further inquire about the origin of a charge or compare it with previous months to check for duplicate deductions or price increases. Claude 可以汇总不同账户的支出，按类别列出花销，也可以生成账单日历或每周支出图表。用户可以继续追问一笔费用来自哪里，或对照以往月份查看是否出现重复扣款和涨价。

Account authorization is read-only, and Claude can read up to two years of transaction history from connected accounts. Anthropic stated that conversations within the personal finance page will not be used to train the model. 账户授权为只读，Claude 最多可读取已连接账户两年的交易记录。Anthropic 表示，个人财务页面内的对话不会用于训练模型。

item.title: 《崩坏：因缘精灵》定档明年春季，终测调整限定卡池
item.guid: 《崩坏：因缘精灵》定档明年春季，终测调整限定卡池
item.description:
miHoYo announced the final beta trailer and gameplay demo for "Honkai: Fated Elves," confirming the game will launch on PC, iOS, and Android in Spring 2027. The final beta will begin on November 25, and registration is now open. 米哈游公布《崩坏：因缘精灵》的终测预告和实机演示，确认游戏将在 2027 年春季登陆 PC、iOS 和 Android。终测将于 11 月 25 日开始，目前已开放报名。

The final beta adjusted the limited character and elf gacha pools: players are guaranteed to obtain the current limited character or elf on their first five-star draw from the corresponding limited pool. After obtaining the current limited character, they can also claim a matching companion elf for free. 终测调整了限定角色和精灵卡池：玩家在相应限定卡池第一次抽到五星时，必定获得当期限定角色或精灵。获得当期限定角色后，还可免费领取与其配对的同行精灵。

This is an open-world role-playing game centered around capturing elves. Players can explore towns and wilderness with their elves, or pair characters with elves for auto-battles. The new demo showcased day-night cycles in cities and enterable shops. 这是一款以捕捉精灵为核心的开放世界角色扮演游戏。玩家可带精灵探索城镇和野外，也可搭配角色与精灵参加自动战斗。新演示展示了城市的昼夜变化和可进入的店铺。

item.title: CygamesEdge 首作《崩落之国》发售，从世界树往下跳
item.guid: CygamesEdge-首作《崩落之国》发售，从世界树往下跳
item.description:
Cygames' new brand CygamesEdge's first game, "Collapsing Country," was released on November 5, launching on PS5, Switch 2, and Steam. The game was co-developed by CygamesEdge and ZEREO, featuring a girl who explores downwards from the branches of the World Tree. Cygames 旗下新品牌 CygamesEdge 的首款游戏《崩落之国》于 11 月 5 日发售，登陆 PS5、Switch 2 和 Steam。游戏由 CygamesEdge 与 ZEREO 共同开发，主角是一名从世界树枝干向下探索的少女。

The main challenge of the game is judging landing points. Players must estimate height and wind direction to jump between collapsing branches and platforms. They can also pick up flower buds and throw them to a designated landing spot, allowing the blooming flowers to cushion their fall. A landing error might require re-traversing a section. 游戏的主要挑战是判断落点。玩家要估算高度和风向，在会崩塌的枝干与平台之间跳跃，也可以捡起花苞扔向预定落点，让长出的花朵缓冲坠落。落地失误则可能要重新走一段路。

item.title: 谷歌视频模型 Omni 1.2 Flash 可生成 15 秒视频，支持对话改片
item.guid: 谷歌视频模型-Omni-1.2-Flash-可生成-15-秒视频，支持对话改片
item.description:
Google launched its video generation model Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, extending the maximum single generation duration from 10 seconds in the previous generation to 15 seconds. Users can then modify the same video within the conversation, for example, by replacing products, adjusting lighting, or switching between landscape and portrait modes. 谷歌推出视频生成模型 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，单次生成时长从上一代最长 10 秒延长到 15 秒。用户可以接着在对话里修改同一段视频，例如替换商品、调光或切换横竖屏。

The new version can combine images and short videos as references, and Google Cloud's audio reference feature is only available to authorized users. Google's demo used multiple rounds of instructions to replace the background of the same clip, preserving the character's performance and camera composition. 新版可以组合图片和短视频作为参考，Google Cloud 的音频参考功能只对获准使用的用户开放。谷歌的演示用多轮指令替换了同一片段的背景，保留了人物的表演与镜头构图。

The model is now officially available on Gemini API and Google Cloud. 720p video is charged at $0.07 per second, 30% lower than the previous generation. In the Gemini app, the 15-second video generation feature is gradually rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers. 模型已在 Gemini API 和 Google Cloud 正式开放。720p 视频每秒收费 0.07 美元，比上一代低 30%。在 Gemini 应用中，15 秒视频生成功能正向 Google AI Ultra 订阅者陆续开放。

item.title: Instagram 剪辑工具 Edits 登陆 Mac，可免费导出无水印 4K 视频
item.guid: Instagram-剪辑工具-Edits-登陆-Mac，可免费导出无水印-4K-视频
item.description:
Instagram brought its video editing tool, Edits, to Mac. The desktop version supports multi-track timelines, transition keyframes, and detailed audio waveforms, and provides color grading tools like color wheels and curves. Instagram 将旗下视频剪辑工具 Edits 带到 Mac。桌面版支持多轨时间线、转场关键帧和精细的音频波形，并提供色轮、曲线等调色工具。

Users can import their own fonts and LUTs, and customize keyboard shortcuts. The app supports various aspect ratios and can export watermark-free 4K videos for free. When posting directly to Instagram, users can add tags and locations, or first use the draft Reels feature to showcase to non-followers. 用户可导入自己的字体和 LUT，也可以自定义键盘快捷键。应用支持多种横竖屏比例，可免费导出无水印 4K 视频。直接发到 Instagram 时，可以添加标签和地点，或先用试发 Reels 功能向非关注者展示。

Audio and text styles saved on mobile are now available on Mac, and Instagram is developing a feature to seamlessly continue editing the same project between mobile and desktop. 手机端保存的音频和文字样式已可在 Mac 上使用，Instagram 正在开发同一剪辑项目在手机与电脑间接续编辑的功能。

item.title: 2027 年放假安排公布，春节从除夕连休 9 天
item.guid: 2027-年放假安排公布，春节从除夕连休-9-天
item.description:
The General Office of the State Council announced the 2027 holiday schedule. The Spring Festival will be from February 5 (Lunar New Year's Eve) to February 13 (the eighth day of the first lunar month), a total of 9 days. January 31 and February 14, both Sundays, will be working days. 国务院办公厅公布 2027 年放假安排。春节从 2 月 5 日除夕放到 2 月 13 日正月初八，共 9 天。1 月 31 日和 2 月 14 日两个周日上班。

Labor Day will be a holiday from May 1 to 5, with May 8 being a working day. National Day will be a holiday from October 1 to 7, with September 26 and October 9 being working days. New Year's Day and Qingming Festival will each have 3 consecutive days off, while Dragon Boat Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival both fall on a Wednesday, each having 1 day off. 劳动节 5 月 1 日至 5 日放假，5 月 8 日上班。国庆节 10 月 1 日至 7 日放假，9 月 26 日和 10 月 9 日上班。元旦和清明节各连休 3 天，端午节和中秋节都落在周三，各放假 1 天。

item.title: 综艺《后会友期》带火鸭舌，淘宝闪购外卖量周环比增逾五成
item.guid: 综艺《后会友期》带火鸭舌，淘宝闪购外卖量周环比增逾五成
item.description:
After the variety show "Hou Hui You Qi" aired, the duck tongues that guest Li Na loved to eat became popular on food delivery platforms. Data from Yicai Global via Taobao Flash Sale shows that since October 30, the platform's duck tongue delivery volume has increased by over 50% week-on-week, with duck tongue orders during lunch and afternoon tea times increasing by 75% and 71% respectively. 综艺《后会友期》播出后，嘉宾厉娜爱吃的鸭舌在外卖平台走红。第一财经从淘宝闪购获得的数据显示，10 月 30 日以来，平台鸭舌外卖量周环比增长超过 50%，午餐和下午茶时段的鸭舌订单分别增长 75% 和 71%。

By brand, Juewei Duck Neck's duck tongue orders on Taobao Flash Sale increased by 200% week-on-week and 280% year-on-year. By city, Changsha, Wuhan, Chongqing, Shenzhen, and Beijing saw the fastest growth in duck tongue orders. 分品牌看，绝味鸭脖在淘宝闪购的鸭舌订单周环比增长 200%，同比增长 280%。分城市看，长沙、武汉、重庆、深圳和北京的鸭舌订单增长最快。

item.title: 亚马逊接入 Uber Eats，美国 Prime 会员可在购物 App 点外卖
item.guid: 亚马逊接入-Uber-Eats，美国-Prime-会员可在购物-App-点外卖
item.description:
Amazon announced a partnership with Uber Eats, allowing eligible Prime members in the US to order food on Amazon.com and the Amazon shopping app. Through Amazon, orders from participating restaurants totaling $25 or more will receive free delivery. 亚马逊宣布与 Uber Eats 合作，美国符合条件的 Prime 会员已可在 Amazon.com 和亚马逊购物 App 里订餐。通过亚马逊向参加活动的餐厅下单，满 25 美元可免配送费。

The partnership covers Uber Eats' chain restaurants and local merchants. For the first 14 days after launch, members will receive a $20 discount on each of their first two eligible orders placed through Amazon. The existing Prime partnership with Grubhub will gradually end as the new service launches. 合作覆盖 Uber Eats 的连锁餐厅和当地商户。上线后的前 14 天，会员在亚马逊下的前两笔符合条件的订单，每笔可减 20 美元。原有的 Prime 与 Grubhub 合作将随新服务上线逐步结束。

item.title: 《嫁金钗》空镜现反向「AI 生成」字样，引发审片讨论
item.guid: 《嫁金钗》空镜现反向「AI-生成」字样，引发审片讨论
item.description:
After "Jia Jin Chai" aired its finale, some viewers noticed the words "AI Generated" in reverse in the upper right corner of a bamboo leaf empty shot in the drama. Urban Scene News reported and displayed a screenshot of this scene. 《嫁金钗》迎来大结局后，有观众发现剧中一段竹叶空镜的右上角留有反向的「AI 生成」字样。都市现场报道展示了这段画面的截图。

The controversy then extended to the review and labeling of long-form dramas. Li Qinyu, chief commentator for The Paper, pointed out in a signed article that editing, color grading, and review processes should all have opportunities to spot anomalies in the footage. If the production team wishes to proactively inform viewers about the use of AI, they could also label the production information in a clearer location. 争议随后延伸到长剧的审片和标注。澎湃新闻首席评论员李勤余在署名文章中指出，剪辑、调色和审片都应有机会发现画面上的异常。如果剧方希望主动提示观众使用了 AI，也可以在更清楚的位置标注制作信息。

item.title: 迈克·李新片《Tender Loving Care》发布预告，聚焦英国照护者
item.guid: 迈克·李新片《Tender-Loving-Care》发布预告，聚焦英国照护者
item.description:
Mike Leigh's new film "Tender Loving Care," which he wrote and directed, has released its trailer. North American distributor Bleecker Street plans to bring the film to theaters in December. 迈克·李编剧并执导的新片《Tender Loving Care》发布预告，北美发行方 Bleecker Street 计划于 12 月将影片带进影院。

Set in post-Brexit England, the film stars Kate O'Flynn as a social worker. She must navigate a series of care challenges in her work while also facing changes in her father's health with her family. 影片以英国脱欧后的英格兰为背景，由凯特·奥弗林饰演一名社工。她既要应对工作中接连出现的照护难题，也要和家人一起面对父亲身体状况的变化。

This film won the Golden Shell for Best Film and the Jury Prize for Best Screenplay at this year's San Sebastian International Film Festival, with O'Flynn jointly receiving the Silver Shell for Best Lead Performance. 本片今年获得圣塞巴斯蒂安国际电影节最佳影片金贝壳奖及评审团最佳编剧奖，奥弗林并列获得最佳主演银贝壳奖。

item.title: 《复仇者联盟 5》公布全球宣传行程，上海列入九站名单
item.guid: 《复仇者联盟-5》公布全球宣传行程，上海列入九站名单
item.description:
Marvel announced the global promotional tour for "Avengers 5," with Shanghai listed among nine stops alongside cities like Seoul, London, and Rome. Marvel also updated its official countdown live stream, where the skyline of each city on the tour will rotate behind Doctor Doom. 漫威公布《复仇者联盟 5》的全球宣传行程，上海与首尔、伦敦、罗马等城市一起列入九站名单。漫威也更新了官方倒计时直播，毁灭博士身后的画面会轮换显示各站城市的天际线。

The film is directed by the Russo Brothers, with Robert Downey Jr. playing Doctor Doom. The North American theatrical release date listed on the Disney Movies official website is December 18. 这部电影由罗素兄弟执导，小罗伯特·唐尼饰演毁灭博士。迪士尼电影官网列出的北美院线上映日期为 12 月 18 日。
